Description:
The title of the form. ACORD 37, Statement of No Loss is used when: 

* A policy issued by your agency has been cancelled, or has lapsed, because premium for the policy was not paid in time;

* The former insured desires to pay the delinquent premium and reinstate insurance without a lapse in coverage; and

* Your contract with the insuring company, or the company's rules, permit policy reinstatement. (You may have to contact your company before
proceeding.)

By signing this form, the former insured certifies that there were no losses, or circumstances that might give rise to a claim under the policy, during the period coverage had lapsed.

This form is also a receipt for the premium payment you collect at the time the form is signed. The form is NOT an insurance binder.
